title: Seven-free square sums of two squares
plain: Show every large seven-free number that is a sum of two squares is a sum of two seven-free squares.
math:
Prove for all large $n$ with $7
otin n$ and $n=a^2+b^2$ solvable, there are $a,b$ with $7
otin a^2$, $7
otin b^2$, $n=a^2+b^2$, or show the exceptional set is infinite.
